Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dil . ov. h OIL G OPINION ND JAN 09 2025 DIRECTOR MARIA LOURDES L. AGUSTIN, CESO Ill Regional Director, DILG NCR 4th Floor, Annex Building-SRA, Sugar Center Compound North Avenue, Diliman, Quezon City Dear RD Agustin: This pertains to your letter dated 16 September 2024 referring to the Central Office, the letter dated 6 August 2024 of Hon. Juliana Rae C. Ibay, President, SK Panlungsod na Pederasyon, City of Manila, requesting guidance on the following matters: 1. Relative to the reorganization of the Sangguniang Panlungsod (SP), can the chairmanship of the SP Committee on Youth and Sports Development by the SK Pederasyon President, being an ex officio member of the SP pursuant to Section 22(b) of Republic Act No. 107421, as amended by Republic Act No. 117682, be given to another SP member? 2. What are the possible legal implications of the violation of the mandatory nature of Section 22 (b) of RA 10742, as amended? 3. What are the possible recourses available, if any? On the first request for guidance, we answer in the negative. Committee chairmanship of the SK Pederasyon President is prescribed under the law Pursuant to Section 22(a) of R.A. No. 10742, as amended by R.A. No. 11768, in relation to Section 41(b) of the Local Government Code (LGC), the duly elected president of the Pederasyon ng Sangguniang Kabataan at all levels shall be the chairperson of the Committee on Youth and Sports Development in their respective 1 An Act Establishing Reforms in the Sangguniang Kabataan Creating Enabling Mechanisms for Meaningful Youth Participation in Nation-Building, and for Other Purposes. 2 An Act Strengthening the Sangguniang Kabataan, Institutionalizing Additional Reforms to Revitalize Youth Participation in Local Governance and by Providing Honorarium, Other Benefits, and Privileges, Amending for the Purpose Certain Sections of Republic Act No. 10742, Otherwise Known as the "Sangguniang Kabataan Reform Act Of 2015" "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No. (02) 8876 3454

Sanggunian. The pertinent provision reads: "SEC. 22. Membership in the Sanggunian and Local Special Bodies xxx (b) He or she shall be the chairperson of the Committee on Youth and Sports Development in the said Sanggunian, and a regular member of the Committees on Education, Environment, Employment and Livelihood, Health and Anti-Drug Abuse, and Gender and Development, xxx It bears to stress that the above-cited provision used the word "shall". Basic is the rule in statutory construction that the use of the word shall in a statute or regulation implies that the statute is mandatory. It means "ought to", "must" and when used in a statute or regulation, expresses what is mandatory. It has invariable significance to impose a duty which may be enforced, particularly if the public is in favor of this meaning or when addressed to public officials, or where public interest is involved, or where the public or persons have rights which ought to be exercised or enforced, unless a contrary intent appears3 Equally basic is the general rule that when the law is clear, explicit and unequivocal, it must be given its literal meaning, there is no room for construction or interpretation. There is only room for application. This is what is known as the plain-meaning rule or verba legis as expressed in the maxim, index animi sermo, or "from the words of a statute there should be no departure". Moreover, it is equally significant to emphasize the rationale for this provision. As the duly elected youth representative at the municipal, city and provincial level, the SK Pederasyon president is the appropriate sanggunian member to direct committee deliberations on all issues affecting the interests and needs of youth in the LGU. Verily, based on the foregoing, chairmanship of the SP Committee on Youth and Sports Development may not be delegated to other SP Members as the law is very clear that it is the duly elected SK Pederasyon president that should preside over said committee. As regards the second query, we opine that violation of the mandatory command of the aforementioned Section 22(a) could possibly constitute misconduct, gross negligence or abuse of authority under Section 60(c) of the Local Government Code depending on the attendant factual circumstances and evidence. Anent the last issue, as already mentioned above, Section 22(a) is mandatory. Thus, the concerned Sanggunian is hereby advised to not give a different interpretation to the said provision and insist on delegating to other SP member the committee chairmanship. To do so, in our opinion, may be sufficient ground to warrant disciplinary action before the proper disciplining authority. 3 Diokno vs. Rehabilitation Finance Corporation , G.R. No. L-4712 July 11, 1952 Page 2 of 2

This opinion is rendered based solely on the facts presented and our appreciation of the same without prejudice to any contrary opinion, decisions, and orders of other government agencies and the courts. Please be guided accordingly. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY A . ROMEO P. ENITEZ Assistant Secretary for Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLNJVRULLLS-LRALLDOvpr Page 2 of 2
